For most schools you don’t need to submit scores but most people do take the ACT or SAT because it’s a test which can show how you compare to your pears. The ACT is out of 36 and consists of 4 sections, English, math, reading, science. The SAT is out of 1600 and consists of reading/writing and math but each has 2 modules. It’s basically just something you put on your college application which allows the college to get a gauge of how you compare to others. (edited)
